cases.input: One activity record produces location- and market-based results.
cases.expect: Two non-additive results pin their own factor and market-evidence inputs.
A successor run preserves original inputs and results.

cases.input: A shared asset is allocated 90 percent across targets.
cases.expect: Results total 0.9 and the remaining 0.1 is exposed as residual.

cases.input: Unreported activity is silently treated as zero.
cases.expect: The run is rejected because missing coverage must remain explicit.

cases.input: Supplier Scope 1 is netted against buyer Scope 3.
cases.expect: The run is rejected because counterparty inventories are not netted.

cases.input: A corrected factor replaces results inside a completed run.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; a successor run is required.

cases.input: An impact result is recorded as a ledger posting without a journal entry.
